title: SubmitRunRequest
description: The body of POST /runs: what to run, with which harness, against which model. The worker resolves the exact, immutable test-case version and the harness image from the backend; the request never names an image. Returns a job id immediately (202 Accepted) — the run proceeds out of band, observed via the status and events endpoints.

version.description: Exact, immutable test-case version to run (e.g. `v1.0.0`). The worker resolves this against the backend; it does not run a floating `latest`.

variant.description: Variant of the case to run (e.g. `base`).

harness.description: Agent harness slug to drive the run (see components/core/harnesses).

model.description: Opaque model id passed through to the harness.

maxRuntimeSeconds.description: Optional override for the maximum harness runtime, in seconds. Omitted, the case's declared default cap applies.
